name: Genius RF
lead: Genius RF is a radiofrequency microneedling platform made by Lutronic. A handpiece with fine insulated needles enters the skin and delivers radiofrequency energy at the needle tips in the dermis. People use it to work on skin texture, fine lines, laxity and acne scars, which are the features that shape how smooth and firm the face looks.[1][2]

The platform was cleared by the US FDA for radiofrequency microneedling in early 2019 and is described as the successor to Lutronic's Infini device.[1][3] Its maker highlights real-time feedback that adjusts energy delivery during each pulse.[1]
Clinics offer it as a series of in-office sessions. In looksmaxxing circles, RF microneedling is discussed as a skin-quality step alongside lasers and peels.

chain: Insulated needles deliver RF energy into the dermis
Skin remodels and produces new collagen
Smoother, firmer skin with softer scars
angle.text: Genius RF is used in clinic to improve skin texture, acne scarring and early laxity. Treatments are usually given as a short series, with the surface of the skin largely spared compared with fully ablative lasers.

paras: The handpiece carries a tip of sterile insulated needles. The needles penetrate to a set depth and the energy is released at their tips, so heating is concentrated in the dermis.[1][3] Lutronic says sensing and feedback algorithms keep energy delivery consistent and allow settings to be adjusted by skin type, area and tissue thickness.[1]
Proponents say the controlled heat triggers new collagen and elastin formation, which is the basis for the smoother, firmer result.[1]

Providers list wrinkles, acne scars and skin laxity as targets, and some state it is suitable across skin tones because of adjustable settings.[3] Dermatologist E. Victor Ross has commented on the quiet motor, ergonomic handpiece and real-time feedback.[1]

timeline.event: Lutronic Genius platform announced as FDA-cleared for RF microneedling.[1]

card.summary: A clinic radiofrequency microneedling device that remodels skin to smooth texture, scars and fine lines.
card.note: Clinic-delivered; results and downtime vary by settings and provider.

quick.overview:
Genius RF is Lutronic's radiofrequency microneedling system, cleared by the FDA in 2019. Fine insulated needles deliver energy into the dermis.

People use it to improve skin texture, acne scars and mild laxity, usually as a series of clinic sessions.
quick.mechanism: Insulated needles enter the skin to a set depth and release RF energy at the tips, heating the dermis to prompt collagen and elastin remodeling. Real-time feedback adjusts delivery.
quick.risks: Treatment is performed by clinicians; temporary redness and swelling are typical of microneedling procedures, and outcomes depend on provider and settings.
